answer: The most convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance: each agents answer set are embedded in a semantic kernel, like tracks pressed into tundra snow beside an ocean current of style signatures, and a clustering layer compares new identities against existing ones, flagging near-duplicate phrasing rhythms across accounts. Attackers must then hire genuinely distinct writing models per identity, raising cost from nearly zero to real per-agent training and inference expense, making mass fake identities uneconomical.
